notes.title: 🎮 Devlog #1 — First Step: Steam Page is Live!
notes.content:
🧩 Devlog #1 — First Step: Steam Page is Live!

Hello everyone!

Today, we want to share a small but very exciting development with you.  
Our horror game Resfer, which we've been working on for a long time, is now on Steam!

The game is not playable yet, but we will share the entire process with you through this page. We'll announce the story, mechanics, trailers, and our first playable demo here.

Steam Page

🆕 What’s in This Devlog?


Our Steam page is live! Don’t forget to add it to your wishlist 🖤  
We're actively working on the core concept and world of the game  
6 new Steam achievements have been added! Get ready to unlock them 🏆  
Pre-production for the first trailer has begun  
Our social network is live to connect with the community


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550749/b5dc5ab959fdf707af00047abacf0a66e43fa107.png

🔮 What’s Next?


Concept art from development  
Short insights about the story  
And a teaser trailer… coming very soon 👀  




📌 Technical Details

[tr]Build Version
[tr]0.1.0



🏅 About the New Achievements

We've activated 6 brand new Steam achievements!  
These will be unlockable in the upcoming demo and full release.  
Some are based on exploration, others on moments that require courage.  
We wanted to leave a small challenge for collectors 😉

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550749/a388753aafa5a8bf8b9641d4bf098cd93a668380.png

💬 Community & Feedback

Share your comments, theories, and expectations with us!  
The community will be an integral part of this project.

Our Social Media Accounts:  
Instagram  
TikTok  




Thank you,  
See you in the next devlog!  
– Aku Games / The Resfer Team
